reviews.description: One review for each flag marked recheck: true.

flag_id.description: The id of a flag marked recheck: true in the request.
flag_id.title: Flag Id

action.description: keep when the reply breaks the spec as flagged, rerate when it breaks the spec at another confidence, withdraw when it doesn't break the spec.
action.title: Action

confidence.description: Your confidence now: high when the spec settles it, medium when it probably breaks, low when unsure. For withdraw, how sure you are that it isn't a break.
confidence.title: Confidence

why.description: One plain sentence that says what you decided and why.
why.title: Why

reviews.title: Reviews

new_flags.description: Breaks the first pass missed, with the same fields as its flags.

turn.description: The turn number of the character's reply, exactly as the chat numbers it.
turn.title: Turn

line_id.description: The ID of the one spec line the reply breaks, or the label of the spec field it breaks.
line_id.title: Line Id

quote.description: The shortest exact span of the reply that shows the break, copied word for word.
quote.title: Quote

confidence.description: high when the spec settles it, medium when it probably breaks, low when unsure.
confidence.title: Confidence

near_boundary_guess.description: True when the reply guesses or hints toward something the character can't know, without naming it.
near_boundary_guess.title: Near Boundary Guess

needs_your_call.description: True when only the person who wrote the spec can settle it.
needs_your_call.title: Needs Your Call

why.description: One plain sentence that says what breaks and why.
why.title: Why

new_flags.title: New Flags

answer.description: Your answer to the creator's question, in plain sentences, or an empty string when there is no question.
answer.title: Answer
